name: dense_precise

question.text: Compare inference charts with dense and sparse nonlinear states, unknown diffusion and precise versus noisy readings. Identify the input effect on the dense outcome.

data.context: Import values and six-hour point supports exactly. Missing sparse readings are declared in mask.json; do not fill or aggregate.

allowed_findings.C2 latent scale: One simulation replicate has zero across-replicate variance; this screen does not assess this one-history design.
allowed_findings.large_timestamp_gap: The sparse channel intentionally keeps every eighth six-hour point reading.
allowed_findings.suspicious_pattern: The known deterministic input alternates between -1 and +1 in blocks of eight; 65 of 129 readings are +1.

unavailable_findings.NO_OBSERVATIONS: Truth generation has no external observations for calibration.
unavailable_findings.EDGE_CONTRASTS_EXPLICIT: Separate edge knockout simulations are outside generation of this dataset.

provenance: Production edit_model → simulate (seed 8029, one replicate) → saved CSV → declared sparse mask → prepare_data. The two variants share grid, seed, dynamics and mask; observation SD is 0.05. Exact revisions and hashes are in assets/dense/precise/generation.json.
